def admit(active, waiting, budget, slots):
    print(f"Input: active={active}, waiting={waiting}, budget={budget}, slots={slots}")
    admitted = []
    remaining = []
    
    # First, check if any waiting reservation exceeds the budget
    for value in waiting:
        if value > budget:
            raise ValueError("Oversized reservation")
    
    # Process waiting reservations in FIFO order
    for i, value in enumerate(waiting):
        print(f"  Processing waiting[{i}]={value}")
        # Check if we have slots available
        if len(admitted) >= slots:
            print(f"    No slots available (admitted count={len(admitted)}, slots={slots})")
            remaining = waiting[i:]
            break
        # Check if adding this reservation would exceed the budget
        current_sum = sum(active) + sum(admitted) + value
        print(f"    Current sum would be {current_sum} (active sum={sum(active)}, admitted sum={sum(admitted)}, value={value})")
        if current_sum > budget:
            print(f"    Budget would be exceeded")
            remaining = waiting[i:]
            break
        print(f"    Admitting {value}")
        admitted.append(value)
    else:
        # If we processed all waiting reservations
        print("  Processed all waiting reservations")
        remaining = []
    
    print(f"  Result: admitted={admitted}, remaining={remaining}")
    return admitted, remaining

def admit(active, waiting, budget, slots):
    # Test case 1: ([6],[5,2],10,3,([],[5,2]))
    # active = [6], waiting = [5,2], budget = 10, slots = 3
    # Expected: admitted = [], remaining = [5,2]
    # Because sum(active) + first waiting = 6 + 5 = 11 > budget (10)
    
    admitted = []
    remaining = []
    for i, value in enumerate(waiting):
        if sum(active) + sum(admitted) + value > budget:
            remaining = waiting[i:]
            break
        if len(admitted) >= slots:
            remaining = waiting[i:]
            break
        admitted.append(value)
    # Check if any waiting reservation exceeds the total budget
    if any(v > budget for v in waiting):
        raise ValueError("Oversized reservation found")
    return admitted, remaining
